items.title: Best Buy, Amazon Deepen Fire TV Alliance
items.summary: Best Buy Co. Inc. (NYSE:BBY) said Wednesday it expanded its multiyear Fire TV partnership with Amazon.com Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN). The deal will keep Fire TV as the exclusive TV software for Insignia televisions. It will also expand connected TV advertising opportunities through Best Buy Ads using Amazon Ads technology. items.title: Best Buy and Amazon Expand Fire TV Partnership Into Connected TV Advertising
items.summary: Best Buy (NYSE:BBY) and Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) have expanded their multiyear Fire TV partnership to include connected television advertising, extending an existing agreement covering Best Buy’s Insignia TVs. Under the agreement, Fire TV will remain the exclusive software experience across all Insignia televisions produced by Best Buy, with models ranging from 24 to 85 inches.
